name: Sawamura Meiko
source:
The head of the Sawamura household. A mature woman who warmly watches over the growth of the protagonist and her two “daughters.”

She’s skilled at mechanical work, but both her job and her past remain a mystery—including those suspicious phone calls from a foreigner.

She’s an expert at Russian cuisine and effortlessly keeps track of the protagonist and heroines’ every move, even discreetly monitoring the their romantic entanglements without being noticed.

She seems to have a romantic interest in the protagonist, but hasn’t made a move yet. Still, she’d like to be part of their group…

[From [url=http://www.sp-janis.com/speed/tabegoro/]official site[/url]]
